title: glasses platform settings
description: Settings of the glasses platform plugin under gateway.platforms.glasses.extra in the Hermes config. glasses/config.py validates with this schema (types, ranges, patterns) plus the rules a schema cannot express (public_url normal form, absolute paths, the 107-byte socket limit, home_lane in lanes). Keys the Hermes gateway itself injects are not ours and are skipped; access-control keys Hermes would act on are refused; any other unknown key is a warning. An unknown key that is a near-miss of a key at the same level (at most max(2, 20 % of that key's length) edits after lower-casing and reading '-' as '_') gets a 'did you mean <key>?' hint, and its name is shown only then and only when it looks like a key name (1-32 characters, an ASCII letter first, then letters, '_' and '-', at most 2 digits); any other name is shown as <an unknown key of N characters> (it could be a pasted secret or forge an output line). x-error / x-errors / x-hint are the user-facing messages ('glasses.<path>: <x-error> (got <value>) — <x-hint>'); a string value is shown only when x-echo is true and it contains neither '@' nor '://' (it could carry credentials); URL- and credential-capable keys (public_url, meeting.endpoint, meeting.provider, meeting.llm.*) are never echoed. x-status: planned marks a key whose feature is not built yet: it is accepted and validated but has no effect.
x-hint: gateway.platforms.glasses.extra holds the settings as key: value pairs

edge.description: The hop from the TLS edge to the plugin: the plugin serves /ws and /enroll only on a unix socket, never on TCP. The edge proxy connects to edge.socket; only a peer running as the system user edge.user is admitted.

socket.description: Absolute path of the plugin's unix socket, at most 107 bytes UTF-8 (the AF_UNIX limit, not characters), without a .. component; empty = unset (the listener then refuses to start; there is no TCP fallback).
socket.x-error: must be an absolute path of at most 107 bytes (UTF-8) without a .. component, surrounding whitespace or control characters, or empty

user.description: System user the TLS edge runs as: the only peer uid the plugin admits on the socket; not root; empty = unset.
user.x-error: must be a user name other than root (lower-case letters, digits, _ and -, at most 32 characters), or empty

edge.x-error: must be a mapping with the keys socket, user

bridge_port.description: Loopback port of the phone bridge (MCP server), bound on 127.0.0.1.

state_dir.description: Absolute directory for the plugin state; empty or null = $HERMES_HOME/glasses. Used today by glasses-admin crl --check (its rollback record crl-seen.json, the highest CRL number seen per CA), config check --live and glasses-admin revoke (it connects to the plugin's admin socket admin.sock here; the server is planned); the plugin keeps no CA key and no CRL here; the plugin's outbox is outbox.sqlite here (mode 0600): it holds the text of each answer until the phone acks it; there is no timer: rows older than 24 h are deleted at the next answer, reconnect or plugin start, a revoked device's rows (purged) at the next answer, its next refused connect or plugin start, and over 500 rows per device the oldest are evicted; the device registry (planned) will live here too. The directory must be owned by the plugin user with mode 0700, the only supported mode: last-seen, the deny overlay and crl --check refuse anything else; the outbox alone tolerates a readable 0755 one but refuses a group- or world-writable one, and then the start fails (retryable).
state_dir.x-error: must be an absolute path without surrounding whitespace or control characters, or empty

public_url.description: Public wss:// URL the app connects to (carried in the enrolment QR); stored normalised.
public_url.x-error: must be empty or a wss:// URL (printable ASCII, no whitespace) with a host, an optional port 1-65535, and no credentials, query or fragment
public_url.x-hint: the wss://<host>/<path> URL of your TLS edge, without user:password@

lanes.description: Global lane allowlist: the lane of an inbound message (msg.in) must be in it and in the device's registry lanes, else the device gets error lane_forbidden; [] = the device's lanes only. At most 32 (= protocol welcome.lanes maxItems).
lanes.x-error: must be a list of lane names
lanes.x-hint: e.g. [assistant, work]; route each lane with gateway.profile_routes

home_lane.description: Lane of an inbound message (msg.in) that names no lane; also the lane of the home channel (glasses:<lane>, planned). Empty = such a message is refused (lane_forbidden). Must be one of lanes when lanes is not empty.
home_lane.x-error: must be empty or a lane name (or glasses:<lane>) matching ^[a-z][a-z0-9_-]{0,31}$
home_lane.x-hint: add it to lanes or pick one of them

client_cert_header.description: HTTP header the TLS edge forwards the client certificate in; the plugin verifies that certificate against the signer's device-ca.pem and never reads a forwarded fingerprint.
client_cert_header.x-error: must be an HTTP header name (letters, digits, '-'; max 64)
client_cert_header.x-hint: the header your edge sets, e.g. X-Client-Cert

client_cert_encoding.x-error: must be one of pem-urlescaped, der-base64
client_cert_encoding.x-hint: pem-urlescaped for nginx, der-base64 for Caddy

long_threshold.description: Characters (1-512 = msg.out.text 2048 B // 4) above which an answer goes to the long-answer platform; UTF-8 bytes > 2048 also count as long.
long_threshold.x-hint: characters shown on the glasses before an answer goes to the long-answer platform; default 280

platform.description: Hermes platform that receives long answers (never glasses itself).
platform.x-error: must be another platform than glasses
platform.x-hint: long answers would loop back to the glasses; use e.g. telegram

long_answers.x-error: must be a mapping with the key platform

signer.description: The device-CA signer: a separate local service (planned, built outside this repository) that the plugin asks to issue and revoke device certificates. Used today: socket and user by glasses-admin crl and glasses-admin revoke, public_dir by glasses-admin crl --check.

socket.description: Absolute path of the signer's unix socket, at most 107 bytes UTF-8 (the AF_UNIX limit, not characters); the plugin refuses it unless it is a socket owned by signer.user; empty = unset.
socket.x-error: must be an absolute path of at most 107 bytes (UTF-8) without surrounding whitespace or control characters, or empty

user.description: System user the signer runs as: the owner of its socket and the peer uid the plugin requires; not root and not the plugin's own user; empty = unset.
user.x-error: must be a user name (lower-case letters, digits, _ and -, at most 32 characters), or empty

public_dir.description: Absolute directory where the signer publishes device-ca.pem, devices-crl.pem and devices.json; glasses-admin crl --check reads the first two; empty = unset. Set up so that the directory and every parent are owned by root or the signer user and not writable by the plugin user, and devices.json is owned by the signer user with mode 0640 or stricter. The plugin itself refuses a directory that is a symlink, owned by the plugin user or writable by group or others, and a devices.json that is missing, a symlink, owned by anyone but the signer user, wider than 0640, oversize or corrupt (it does not check the parents). In each of those cases no new device connection is accepted; cutting sessions that are already live is the watcher of T1.63a (not built yet).
public_dir.x-error: must be an absolute path without surrounding whitespace or control characters, or empty

signer.x-error: must be a mapping with the keys socket, user, public_dir

meeting.description: Settings of meeting mode. Off unless enabled here and per device.

provider.x-error: must be one of soniox, deepgram, speechmatics
provider.x-hint: the key stays on the server: the plugin reads it from the provider's environment variable in the gateway environment (supply it from a secret manager); the phone only gets short-lived tokens

endpoint.description: Provider host (region); empty = the provider default.
endpoint.x-error: must be empty or a lower-case DNS host name

language_hints.x-error: must be a list of language tags

x-errors.maxItems: must have at most 8 language tags
x-errors.uniqueItems: must not repeat a language tag

daily_hours.x-hint: daily cap of meeting hours; 0 = no daily cap

llm.description: Optional provider/model passed to the plugin LLM API; empty = the deployer's active model.

provider.x-error: must be empty or a provider name (lower-case letters, digits, '_', '.', '-')

model.x-error: must be empty or a model name (printable ASCII, no spaces)

llm.x-error: must be a mapping with the keys provider, model

meeting.x-error: must be a mapping of meeting settings
meeting.x-hint: reserved for meeting mode; leave it out until you use it

lane.description: Lane name; same pattern as the protocol lane (protocol/envelope.schema.json).
lane.x-error: must be a lane name matching ^[a-z][a-z0-9_-]{0,31}$
lane.x-hint: lower-case letters, digits, '_' and '-', starting with a letter

platform.description: Hermes platform name; same pattern as the protocol platform.
platform.x-error: must be a Hermes platform name matching ^[a-z][a-z0-9_-]{0,31}$

langTag.description: BCP 47 language tag; same pattern as the protocol langTag.
langTag.x-error: must be a language tag such as en or pt-BR
